title: Glue JSON
description: Schema for neural model composition (glue) files that define how multiple models are merged into block-diagonal layers.

input_mapping.description: Identifier for the combined input mapping function.

output_mapping.description: Identifier for the combined output mapping function.

initial_state.description: Initial state values for models that require persistent state (e.g., counters). Keys are model names.

name.description: Unique identifier for this model within the glue file.

path.description: Relative path to the model JSON file.

merged_layers.description: List of merged layers defining the block-diagonal composition.

activation.description: Activation function applied after this layer.

model.description: Reference to a model name in the 'models' array.

layer.description: Index of the layer within the referenced model.

in_offset.description: Offset into the input vector for this block.

out_offset.description: Offset into the output vector for this block.

output_ranges.description: Named regions of the output vector.

offset.description: Start offset within the output vector.

size.description: Number of elements in this region.
